en: A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) view over a small town with many trees and pitched-roof houses. On the left stands a prominent church with a baroque-style tower and onion dome. To the right are larger institutional-looking buildings along a main street. The title printed in red at the top reads "Großröhrsdorf. Mitteldorf." indicating the central part of the town Großröhrsdorf.
